item.title: Persona 6 Doesn't Have A Date Yet, But Atlus Says You Won't Have To Wait As Long For Persona 7

description.p: A'ight, slow down.There's been a lot of talk around how long GTA fans have been waiting for the latest entry to launch, but Persona isn't actually that far behind. Persona 5 – in its original state – released over a decade ago on 15th September 2016, and although Persona 6 has now been officially announced, we're none the wiser as to when it will actually come out.It's likely to finally land at some point in 2027 after the dust has settled from Persona 4 Revival, but according to a recent interview with general producer Kazuhisa Wada (thanks, Nintendo Everything), fans won't have to wait quite so long for the inevitable Persona 7.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Top 20 Best-Selling Wii Games Of All Time Revealed (US)

description.p: Wa wa Wii wa!In case you need another reminder of how old you are, the Wii has just turned 20 years old in North America (those in Europe have until 8th December to hit the milestone).To celebrate, Circana's Mat Piscatella has posted a breakdown of the top 20 best-selling Wii games of all time. For anyone clued in, the list won't be particularly surprising, but it's definitely a stark reminder of how weird the Wii generation was. It was chock full of simple, casual games that you just don't see these days – at least not to the same degree, Just Dance is still very much a thing, of course.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
